purpose: 讓三晨星、光譜、策展集以及各產品 projection 共用同一內容身份，不複製 underlying content，也不讓 editorial layer 變成工具或內容 owner。
ownerRule: Every content object has one canonical owner/resolver. 三晨星、光譜、策展集 only point to it. A projection may alter presentation but never identity or ownership.

threeMorningStars.rule: Eligibility never equals selection; absence is valid.

spectrum.rule: Multiple simultaneous coordinates are allowed; coordinates do not create categories or duplicate content.

curatedSet.rule: Members may cross owner surfaces and media; set order/composition belongs to the set, underlying identity does not.

layoutContract.threeMorningStars: sparse emphasis; never fill empty slots artificially
layoutContract.spectrum: continuous relational field; no equal-tab/filter-panel reduction
layoutContract.emptyRule: No concrete content = no public structural placeholder.

translationContract.rule: Language projection is presentation/reading state, never canonical identity mutation.

migration: Existing Jerusalem 3000 normalized pointers and Jiang Xiuqin Inner Life specimen can migrate to this contract without changing their old editorial rules.
next: Use this contract when normalizing additional content and when building layout data adapters; do not invent a separate schema per surface.
